name: Hisho Saori
source:
Yuya is an otaku. However, he has pull with a big company and enters it. One day, he meets a beautiful girl at office and soon falls in love with her. To be a suitable man for her, he decides to work hard and succeed. But the other female workers tease him persistently...

Yuya finally gets mad and...
